caption: A flock of birds flies over a sunlit field, and their shadows race across the grass below them.

sa.check: A flock of birds flies over a field.
Their shadows race across the grass below them.
There are several birds and several shadows.

pc.expect: Each shadow moves at the same speed and direction as its bird.
pc.fail: The shadows lag or lead; or move the opposite way; or stay still while the birds fly.

pc.expect: There are as many shadows as birds, and none appears where no bird passes.
pc.fail: Shadows appear with no bird above; or there are more shadows than birds; or shadows persist after the birds have gone.

pc.expect: The shadows are offset toward the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: They lie toward the sun; or directly below with a plainly low sun; or in different directions for one flock.

pc.expect: The shadows do not move on their own.
pc.fail: A shadow moves while its bird hovers; or the shadows scatter while the flock holds together.

pc.expect: The birds keep their wings and the shadows keep bird shapes.
pc.fail: A bird loses a wing; or a shadow becomes a solid object; or shadows merge into one blob under a spread flock.

pc.expect: The field and the birds stay the same, and the shadows stay dark.
pc.fail: The field changes; or the shadows turn coloured; or the birds change colour.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
